notes.title: tanxy 1.0.3 is ready
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW:
[list]
[*] Updated graphics.
[/list]

BREAKING CHANGES:
[olist]
[*] unit.run() method renamed to unit.loop().
[*] New format of .tanxy battle file is not compatible with .tanxy from 1.0.0, 1.0.1, and 1.0.2.
[/olist]

notes.title: tanxy 1.0.1 is ready
notes.content:
[h3]WHAT'S NEW[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Performance improved.
[*] A lot of bugs fixed.
[*] JavaScript API extended.
[/olist]
[h3]BEWARE![/h3]
Incompatible JavaScript API change: [b]unit.angleTo()[/b] method is removed. Please look at the new examples to see how to use the new API.
